_comment: MIRROR, not original. The manifest contract is declared by the producer in
the core repository: system/contracts/manifest-contract.yaml. Core enforces
it on every build_manifest call, so a projection change fails core's own
tests before it can reach this repository.
This file is what lets UI CI fail closed against a manifest it does not
understand, and what scripts/check-contract.mjs holds the fixture vault to.
Update it in the SAME change as a core bump - v2 to v3 exists because core
shipped a top-level 'topics' collection while still announcing v2 (ADR-009,
v3 also records workspace_to_modules and workspace_to_units, which core has
emitted since the v2 baseline: nothing ever compared this lock against a
real core build, so the omission survived unnoticed.
